final.answer: The transmitter feeding FIC-2-2 is FT-2-2 (a Rosemount 3051). It has no fixed fail direction: on a detected sensor or microprocessor failure the 4–20 mA output is driven either high or low, and the direction is user-selectable via a jumper/switch inside the transmitter. You can change the direction either with the internal jumper/switch or by ordering the desired alarm-levels option code from the factory (C4 = NAMUR high, CN = NAMUR low, CR/CS = custom high/low, CT = Rosemount standard low); these options apply only to the HART 4–20 mA output. Tool result:
Datasheet fisher-et-d100022x012, pages [6, 18, 7, 2, 19, 10, 3]:
Yes — the valve comes with either metal-to-metal seating or metal-to-PTFE seating, and its leakage (shutoff) class depends on that choice: standard shutoff is Class IV per ANSI/FCI 70-2 and IEC 60534-4, with Class V or VI available as options, and TSO (Tight Shutoff) trim is factory tested for no leakage [p. 6].

Details (all from Table 4, "Shutoff Classifications Per ANSI/FCI 70-2 and IEC 60534-4", p. 6 — ANSI/FCI is the industry standard for rating valve leakage when closed):

- Standard shutoff: **Class IV** for all constructions with metal seating (all except Cavitrol III cages, and for the ET with Cavitrol III one-stage cage) [p. 6].
- Optional **Class V**:
  - With PTFE seating (standard construction, no Cavitrol III cage), also available with an air test [p. 6].
  - With metal seating: requires a spring-loaded seal ring, radius-seat plug and wide-bevel seat ring; not available with the 8-in. port or quick-opening cage, and not with trims 4, 29 and 85 [p. 6].
  - Standard for the ET with Cavitrol III two-stage cages (metal seating) [p. 6].
- Optional **Class VI** (available with soft seat and metal seat constructions; see Tables 6 and 7 on p. 7):
  - Metal seat: port sizes 3.4375–7 in., minimum seat load 300 lbs/lineal inch; not for NPS 8; limited retrofit capability — consult your Emerson sales office [p. 7, Table 6].
  - Soft seat: same port size range, but the minimum seat load is given in Catalog 14, not in this datasheet [p. 7, Table 6].
- **TSO (Tight Shutoff) trim** (ET and EAT, CL125–600, with a replaceable protected soft seat): TSO is not an ANSI/FCI leakage class. Valves with TSO trim are factory tested to a more stringent Emerson requirement of no leakage at time of shipment; the test medium is water. Shutoff class is V.
